implications: Overweight MEASURE/WRITE/GROW interfaces: scientific instrumentation, DNA synthesis, cell culture/bioreactors, lab automation, metrology. Watch bottleneck migration: today's memory wall (DRAM ETF regime) rhymes with tomorrow's biofoundry wall. Convexity lives in $100M-$5B bottleneck owners, not the model layer.
statement: As intelligence approaches abundance, value migrates toward privileged access to reality: the scarce asset is not models or theories (Levin's corpus is public) but the closed loop of automated experiment + living system + measurement + proprietary data. Biology becomes programmable at the goal-state level (prompt biology, don't micromanage molecules), and the investment layer is MEASURE/WRITE/GROW/ACT/VERIFY interfaces.
title: Access to reality is the scarce asset
